why: Nothing in the results answers the shopper's actual question. The major names present are a Verge news item on Apple's own MagSafe puck, a Verge deal post on one Anker dock, a TechRadar hidden-features list and a generic Popular Mechanics charger roundup, none testing 25W chargers against the iPhone 17 or explaining the adapter requirement. The rest are Facebook AI summaries, a 2025 rumor thread, Wikipedia spec pages, an Alibaba AI guide and two single-brand store pages (UGREEN, Elecdov). A focused page listing Qi2.2 25W chargers confirmed on iPhone 17, with the needed adapter wattage, charge-time data, current prices and tested codes would have no real competition.
